# ffxf_database_options (Data Source)

Reads FFXF Cloud database API data. Database features are in beta; accounts without access receive HTTP 403.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_database_options" "available" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `options_json` (String) Database engines, versions, extensions, sizes, and pricing options as JSON.
